findings.description: SYS-SUP-002 states that a start delay equal to the limit is within the limit but names test as its verification method. CON-SUP-147 requires a requirement stating the equality rule to name analysis; the specified margin tests do not verify equality.
findings.requested_change: Align the stated verification method with CON-SUP-147, or remove the repeated equality statement and rely on SYS-SUP-005.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-003 states that an execution time equal to the limit is within the limit but names test as its verification method. CON-SUP-147 requires a requirement stating the equality rule to name analysis; the specified margin tests do not verify equality.
findings.requested_change: Align the stated verification method with CON-SUP-147, or remove the repeated equality statement and rely on SYS-SUP-092.
